fusions.name: Full Tilt
fusions.desc: Charges you to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes, which deals 12 damage, rising to twice that at full reach.

fusions.name: Spurred Trample
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Tramples in a tight circle, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves you moving 20% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Heart's Hoofbeat
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 20% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gathered Stride
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
